title: fix(cli): os build runs the override write gate os validate runs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X6A9L2waqB8UEYtAxtpZGhG)_

Fixes #28643

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches the `overrides` declaration or a `.custom` package; `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` already says `os validate` and `os build` run the same gates, which this diff makes true for one more gate.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`os build` 现在会跑 `os validate`、发布接口和托管安装已经在跑的「覆盖声明」判定（同一个 `findOverrideDeclarationRefusals`），命中就报同样的行、退出码 1，不写产物。
- **为什么改**：以前 `os build` 照样产出这种产物，要等到安装或发布时才被同一个判定拒掉；现在在构建时就拒，作者早知道。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只收紧 `os build`：它现在拒的产物，任何一个落地口本来就会拒；干净的配置产物字节不变。回滚即删 `compile.ts` 里新加的那一段。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts`（新增的 3b-iii 段）；`packages/cli/test/build-override-declarations.test.ts`（与 `os validate` 同进程比对）；`packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts`（台账行从 VALIDATE_ONLY 挪到 SHARED）。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd packages/cli && pnpm exec vitest run --project unit test/build-override-declarations.test.ts`，预期 4/4 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts`: new step 3b-iii, right before the dependency-range check (3b-quater) and ahead of every artifact write. It calls `findOverrideDeclarationRefusals(result.data)`, the same call `os validate` makes at its step 3a-iii, over the same walk (`utils/override-declarations.ts`, reused unchanged) and the publish door's own judge (`judgeOverrideWrite`). On any row it exits 1 and writes no artifact. The `--json` face is this command's failure envelope (`{ success: false, errors, warnings, conversions }`, the shape the view-container refusal at step 3a uses) with the rows `os validate --json` carries on `errors`. The text face prints the same heading and `PATH [CODE] MESSAGE` bullets `os validate` prints. No second spelling of the judge: the messages are the judge's.
- `packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts`: the `findOverrideDeclarationRefusals` row leaves `VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES` (now empty again, its steady state) and joins `SHARED_NON_REGISTRY_GATES`, where both commands are held to it. The ledger header now names both rows it has held.
- `packages/cli/test/build-override-declarations.test.ts` (new, unit tier, in-process): runs `Compile` and `Validate` in the same process (`Command.run`, no CLI spawn) over three `defineStack` configs. (1) A dependent declaring `overrides` of `com.acme.crm` (only `com.acme.crm.custom` may) and (2) a `packages[]` stack whose dependent ships the base's dashboard name undeclared: `os build --json` exits with `os validate`'s exit code, its `errors` deep-equal `os validate --json`'s `errors`, and no artifact exists. (3) The text face prints `os validate`'s refusal block verbatim and not `Build complete`. CONTROL: the base's paired `.custom` declaring the same override builds and validates clean.
- `.changeset/28643-build-override-write-gate.md`: `@objectstack/cli` patch, both declaration lines, and an ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition (the gate asks for one on a `(narrowing)` arm).

Not touched: `validate.ts`, `override-declarations.ts`, the judge, every door. This is a product refusal in a CLI command; no repo/CI gate is added.

## Why

PR #28554 (#28410) wired the override write gate into the publish doors, `os validate` and the managed install, and honestly recorded `os build` as a `VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES` gap. So `os build` emitted an artifact that the install or a publish door later refused with the same judge: a late refusal, never a false acceptance. Triage `6557795179` answered A: wire the existing judge into the build.

## Tests

<details><summary>Red first on origin/main 0b6a52e8: os build emits what os validate refuses</summary>

Spawned `node packages/cli/bin/run-dev.js` (source entry) in scratch projects with spec linked, before the edit:

```
partner (dependent declares overrides of com.acme.crm)
  os build --json   exit=0  {"success":true,...,"dashboards":1}   dist/objectstack.json written
undeclared (packages[]: com.acme.partner ships dashboard crm_board, which com.acme.crm in its closure ships)
  os build --json   exit=0  {"success":true,...,"dashboards":2}   dist/objectstack.json written
  os validate --json exit=1 errors=[{path:"packages[1].manifest.dashboards[0]",code:"NOT_OVERRIDABLE",rule:"undeclared_same_name",packageId:"com.acme.partner",...}]
pair (com.acme.crm.custom declares the same override)
  os build --json   exit=0  artifact sha256 638c0fb8…b0b3a6
```
</details>

<details><summary>Green with the fix (same scratch projects, same entry)</summary>

```
partner     os build --json exit=1 {"success":false,"errors":[{"path":"dashboards[0]","code":"NOT_OVERRIDABLE","rule":"declared_outside_pair","packageId":"com.acme.partner",...}]}  no dist/
undeclared  os build --json exit=1 errors=[{path:"packages[1].manifest.dashboards[0]",code:"NOT_OVERRIDABLE","rule":"undeclared_same_name",...}]  no dist/
undeclared  os build (text) exit=1, prints the same heading and bullet as os validate (text):
  ✗ The publish door would refuse 1 item under the override write gate (ADR-0146 D2)
  • packages[1].manifest.dashboards[0] [NOT_OVERRIDABLE] 'dashboard/crm_board' in package 'com.acme.partner' bears the name of the dashboard 'com.acme.crm' ships, ...
pair        os build --json exit=0, artifact sha256 638c0fb8…b0b3a6 — byte-identical to base (control)
```

`os validate` output is unchanged: `validate.ts` is not in the diff.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: removing the call reds the pin, the control stays green</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `compile.ts`, anchor `const overrideRefusals = findOverrideDeclarationRefusals(result.data as Record<string, unknown>);` replaced with an empty row list (anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `101f6bc6` → `597254ac`). The test imports `src/` directly, so no rebuild is involved.

```
× THE PIN (partner) · × THE PIN (undeclared) · × the text face ...
Tests  3 failed | 1 passed (4)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (101f6bc62f2f) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```
</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and dogfood</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` then `pnpm exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` (cli), under the lock at `3ed0c554`: typecheck clean; `Test Files 364 passed (364) · Tests 5167 passed (5167) · VERDICT command-exit 0`. The new file: 4/4, tests 4.6 s (first case 4.3 s is the command graph import).
- The `integration` tier is declared to CI: the diff touches no spawn entry and no integration-tier file.
- Full dogfood (the `(narrowing)` arm), `@objectstack/dogfood^...` built, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock at `3ed0c554`: `Test Files 369 passed | 3 skipped (372) · Tests 2981 passed | 28 skipped (3009) · VERDICT command-exit 0`. Head `9d2ea032` adds only the changeset's ADR-0087 line on top of it.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The text-face heading (`The publish door would refuse N items under the override write gate (ADR-0146 D2)`) is written in `compile.ts` as it is in `validate.ts`, the same way the #20393 view-container refusal is written in both. Folding it into one exported heading (the `picklistRefusalHeading` shape) would edit `validate.ts`, which is outside this claim's file surface. The test pins the build's block EQUAL to `os validate`'s, so the two cannot drift silently.
- Placement follows the ruling: beside `checkDependencyRanges`. `os validate` runs the gate a few steps earlier (3a-iii, before its dependency-range step 3e); both refuse before any artifact write, so the accept set is the same.
- Overlap: re-read before opening. No open PR touches `compile.ts`, `override-declarations.ts` or the parity test (open PRs 28666, 28662, 28654, 28651, 28650, 28499 checked by file list).

## Verification

Derived gate loop (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 61 families) at `3ed0c554`, changeset gates re-run at `9d2ea032`: 60 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED. `dispatch-gates --ran`: `61 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 60 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`. Record: `pm-orders/server/28643-gates-ran.txt`.

- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: needs every package's `dist/` (a full `pnpm build`), here `packages/apps/studio/dist` was absent; CI runs it.
- `check:type-check-debt` and `check:i18n-coverage` first read exit 3 (lock queue-timeout behind the dogfood hold; showcase deps unbuilt) and were re-run under the lock: `check-type-check-coverage --re-measure: OK — 0 raw tsc error(s)` and `check-i18n-coverage: OK (14 config(s), 527 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`.
- `check-adr-0087-registration` read exit 1 before the disposition line was added, exit 0 after.
- CI owns the repo-wide lint and every family outside the derived set.
